en-US.name: Sahayak Life Assistant
en-US.shortDescription: Voice companion for daily briefings, tasks, habit tracking, spending, and health.
en-US.fullDescription: Sahayak Life manages your daily productivity, finances, and personal wellness. Get morning briefings, run Pomodoro focus timers, build habits, capture quick notes, track personal expenses and group bill splits, manage category budgets, and log vital health metrics and medication reminders by voice.
examplePhrases: What is on my schedule today?
Start a twenty-five minute focus session.
Split the dinner bill equally among four people.
Log blood pressure one twenty over eighty.
